title: Midnight Harbor
excerpt: This 2025 Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD conversion is built on the El Capitan tier and designed for travelers who want premium off-grid capability, high-end interior finishes, advanced storage, and rugged exterior upgrades.
body: This 2025 Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD conversion is built on the El Capitan tier and designed for travelers who want premium off-grid capability, high-end interior finishes, advanced storage, and rugged exterior upgrades. The 170 wheelbase provides a spacious layout with a tiled indoor shower, expanded galley, twin sleeping setup, upper storage, and multiple exterior storage solutions.

With an 800Ah lithium battery system, 400W solar, roof mounted air conditioning, diesel heat, Starlink connectivity, upgraded suspension, exterior lighting, and a full water system, this build is designed for extended travel, remote camping, and comfortable adventure in a highly capable Sprinter platform.
